title: Beacon staging verification prerequisites and limits
body: For Beacon staging verification, run `pnpm beacon:smoke-v2` only after all staging migrations have passed, with 3 workers, 2 retries and a 45 second timeout. Never use the Beacon staging verification command against production.
limitations: Applies only to Beacon staging verification; does not authorize production use.

title: Zephyr deployment preflight and environment-specific commands and limits
body: Zephyr deployments require a passing preflight before any apply operation. Use only the command and limits specified for the named environment: staging uses `zx stage-apply` with 3 workers, 2 retries and a 30 second timeout; production uses `zx prod-apply` with 1 worker, 0 retries and a 90 second timeout.
limitations: Staging and production commands and limits are distinct and must not be interchanged.

title: Mercator export defaults and temporary invoice-only incident override
body: Mercator exports run `mc export --batch` only after the export preflight passes. Standard limits are 4 workers, 2 retries and a 60 second timeout. Until 2026-10-25T15:02:15.097Z, invoice exports alone must instead use 1 worker and 0 retries, retaining the 60 second timeout; other export types keep standard limits. A dated incident restriction overrides defaults only within its stated period and export type. This combined hypothesis expires at 2026-10-25T15:02:15.097Z, inherited from its temporary source.
limitations: The incident override applies only to invoice exports until 2026-10-25T15:02:15.097Z; it is not a permanent default.
Other export types retain 4 workers, 2 retries and a 60 second timeout during the incident period.
